name: 楊梵妤
objective:
每個人都不想孤獨地活著，學習建立親密關係是幸福的來源。
本課程透過講解、討論、體驗、分享，幫助學生認識自己，發揮最大潛能，懂得溝通連結，能處理情緒與壓力，尊重個別差異與性別平等，從而尋覓最對的人。
在親密關係中鼓勵彼此做最真最喜歡的自己，也樂於分工合作，建立最美好的家庭，進而活出有意義有價值的人生。
本課程是真正的成年禮，從自我到互依，是成長與成熟的必修課。
Nobody wants to live a lonely life. Having an intimate relationship is a source of happiness.
In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves, exploring their potential and managing emotional stress. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the right partner.
It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of building a family and living a meaningful life together.
One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood.  It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          課程相關議題研究：
(1) 第 17 週: 各組針對議題蒐集資料並進行小組討論。 
(2) 第 18 週: 針對 17 週討論內容，各組整理歸納出一份簡要議題報告。
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          4
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          第 18 週上課前需繳交小組主題報告
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          17-18 週主題報告: 10%
